description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Premier Global Links LLC is seeking a Software Engineer for an AI technology organization developing software for the semiconductor and chip design industry. The role focuses on building software solutions and integrations for RTL development, chip design, and verification workflows, while collaborating with customer engineering teams and internal R&D.
Software Engineer building semiconductor RTL design and verification tools, integrating simulators and testbenches, and deploying customer solutions

Responsibilities:
• Work directly with semiconductor design and verification teams to understand technical challenges and develop practical solutions
• Build software capabilities that support RTL development, simulation, chip design, and verification workflows
• Develop code and integrations connecting software tools with customer design environments, testbenches, simulators, and verification systems
• Collaborate with internal R&D engineers and customer-side technical experts to turn real-world engineering problems into working software
• Take ownership of customer projects from problem discovery through solution development and deployment
• Support customer engineering teams through hands-on technical collaboration and solution implementation
• Identify opportunities to improve semiconductor design and verification processes using software and AI-powered tools

Requirements:
• Background in Electrical Engineering (EE), Computer Engineering (CE), Computer Science (CS), or a related technical field
• Practical knowledge of Verilog, SystemVerilog, and RTL design or verification
• Programming experience with Python and C
• Understanding of semiconductor design, digital logic, simulation, or design verification workflows
• Ability to understand complex engineering problems and develop software-based solutions
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills
• Effective communication skills and willingness to work directly with customer engineering teams
• Recent graduates with relevant semiconductor, chip design, or design verification internships and hands-on technical experience
• Engineers with approximately 1+ years of experience as a Design Verification Engineer, Applications Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or similar professional at a semiconductor or EDA company
• Candidates with up to approximately 8 years of relevant experience are welcome to apply
• Candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without requiring employer-sponsored visa support

Preferred:
• Experience with commercial Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools
• Familiarity with UVM, formal verification, FPGA development, or simulation environments
• Experience with C++, Tcl, or Makefiles
• Exposure to AI agents, AI-powered engineering tools, or LLM-based development workflows
• Previous customer-facing engineering or technical consulting experience
• Interest in transitioning from traditional hardware design or verification into software engineering and AI applications
